mentions.name: The Cemetery of Friendships
mentions.description: This app is a first-MVP interactive experience called The Cemetery of Friendships, a free-to-try activity for working through memories and grief from ended friendships, ideally used with a notebook and pen.
mentions.problem: Grief and unresolved memories from ended friendships that people need to process.
mentions.audience: People with memories and grief around friendships to work through, ideally bringing a notebook and pen.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://angryangels.sarah-rosenhahn.de/try-the-cemetery-of-friendships-for-free/

please don't hug to death, I only got 10 GB of Data

it's 1st MVP and I got a dayjob, so please be kind. Haven't put out a howto yet, but ideally you have a notebook and a pen, some memories and grief to work through.
